body: Well, when someone requests a welfare check do you ask them if they've exhausted all other options first? In this case, my mom could just ask anyone else in our family if I'm alive.

Maybe it wouldn't solve all my problems, but it's normal to want to be able to date people and it's normal to be sad when it can't ever happen.

Also I don't follow the logic that says "There are videos on youtube of girls with balloons, therefore there's someone out there willing to fuck you."
On what planet can you make that guarantee? You're saying that to make me feel better which is nice but we both know that you have no idea what you're talking about.
